描述_EN: in march 2014, facebook acquired oculus for $2 billion, shortly before sony unveiled its own virtual reality headset, project morpheus. at game developer conference in san francisco in march 2014 oculus announced the dk2, which added higher resolution screens, positional tracking and better refresh rates. the dk1 was released for sale on 26 september 2012. the oculus rift development kit 1 is the first version of the headset that was sent out to software developers and programmers. the oculus rift is the leading device that could bring virtual reality – an immersive, three dimensional experience of a computer generated world – into living rooms across the world. what began as a garage invention, then a successful kickstarter campaign, could become a ubiquitous device of home entertainment in the near future. the rift was invented by 21-year-old american tech entrepreneur palmer luckey, who built the prototypes when he was just 18. he hacked together two separate screens (one for each eye) with magnifying glasses that give the rift a unique 90 degree field of vision. it consists of a headset integrating two screens (one for each eye running at 640x800 ppi resolution per eye, adding up to an overall resolution of 1280x800), two aspheric lenses, 9-axis head tracking technology and a cable between the headset and the interface that connects the headset to the computer. this capacity and the lack of lag (the effect when the image on the screen lags behind as you move your head, responsible for motion sickness in other vr headsets) impressed many.
描述_ZN: 2014年3月，Facebook以20亿美元的价格收购了Oculus，不久之后，索尼发布了自己的虚拟现实头盔，Project Morpheus。 2014年3月在旧金山举行的游戏开发者大会上，Oculus宣布了DK2，它增加了更高的分辨率屏幕、位置追踪和更好的刷新率。 DK1于2012年9月26日发布销售。 oculus rift开发套件1是发送给软件开发人员和程序员的头盔的第一个版本。 Oculus rift是一个领先的设备，它可以将虚拟现实--一种对计算机生成的世界的身临其境的三维体验--带入世界各地的客厅中。 从车库发明开始，然后是成功的kickstarter活动，在不久的将来可能会成为一个无处不在的家庭娱乐设备。 裂缝是由21岁的美国科技企业家帕尔默-勒基发明的，他在年仅18岁时就制造了原型。 他将两个独立的屏幕（每只眼睛一个）与放大镜黑在一起，使裂缝具有独特的90度视野。 它包括一个集成了两个屏幕（每只眼睛一个，每只眼睛的分辨率为640x800 ppi，加起来的总分辨率为1280x800）、两个非球面镜片、9轴头部追踪技术以及耳机和连接耳机和电脑的接口之间的电缆的耳机。 这种能力和缺乏滞后性（当你移动头部时，屏幕上的图像会滞后，这在其他VR头盔中会造成晕动症）给许多人留下了深刻印象。
